text: A song of ascents. I Out of the depths [1] I call to you, Lord;
Lord, hear my cry!May your ears be attentiveto my cry for mercy. [AA]
If you, Lord, keep account of sins,Lord, who can stand? [AB]
But with you is forgivenessand so you are revered. [2]
II I wait for the Lord,my soul waitsand I hope for his word. [AC]
My soul looks for the Lordmore than sentinels for daybreak. [AD]More than sentinels for daybreak,
let Israel hope in the Lord,For with the Lord is mercy,with him is plenteous redemption, [AE]
And he will redeem Israelfrom all its sins. [AF]
